ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- Orden: (vars.responseOrquestador.Ordenes filter ((value) -> value.Estado == vars.status))[0]

%dw 2.0 output application/json var splitEstados = splitBy(p('estados'), "|") -- [""] var orderCriteria = {(splitEstados map {(($) : ($$))})} --- Orden: (vars.responseOrquestador.Ordenes filter ((value) -> splitEstados contains(value.Estado)) orderBy (order) -> orderCriteria[order.Estado])[0]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var valueDate = (payload.Orden.InformacionAdicional filter ($.Nombre == "date")).Valor[0] --- (p('dataEnable') as Boolean) and !isEmpty(valueDate) and (valueDate < (now() >> "America/Bogota") as String)
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- if (p('noRecords') as Boolean) 200 else 500
